const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process'),crypto=require('node:crypto');const root="/results/87fa5834-7457-46c3-965f-27f5ae181091";const done=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(root+'/run.json'));if(!done.complete||!done.success)throw Error('Final validation must complete');const file='benchmark/write-cache/capacity_probe_test.go.txt';fs.writeFileSync(file,Buffer.from("",'base64'));fs.chownSync(file,10001,10001);const overlay='benchmark/write-cache-capacity.json';fs.writeFileSync(overlay,JSON.stringify({Replace:{'/app/internal/runthrough/write_cache_capacity_test.go':'/app/'+file}}));const checks=[];for(const[name,args]of [['format',['gofmt','-w',file]],['measure',['go','test','-overlay='+overlay,'./internal/runthrough','-run','^TestOutboxWriteCacheCapacityProbe$','-v','-count=1']]]){const fd=fs.openSync(root+'/capacity-'+name+'.log','w');let q;try{q=cp.spawnSync('runuser',['-u','stow-validation','--',...args],{stdio:['ignore',fd,fd],env:{...process.env,TMPDIR:root},timeout:45000})}finally{fs.closeSync(fd)}checks.push({name,args,exitCode:q.status,signal:q.signal});if(q.status!==0)throw Error('Capacity '+name+' failed')}const rows=fs.readFileSync(root+'/capacity-measure.log','utf8').split('\n').filter(x=>x.startsWith('STOWCAPACITY:')).map(x=>JSON.parse(x.slice('STOWCAPACITY:'.length)));if(rows.length!==3||rows.some(x=>x.length>x.capacity))throw Error('Capacity samples incomplete');fs.copyFileSync(file,root+'/source-capacity_probe_test.go.txt');const receipt={railwayDeploymentId:process.env.RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_ID,checks,rows,sourceSHA256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest('hex')};fs.writeFileSync(root+'/capacity-receipt.json',JSON.stringify(receipt,null,2)+'\n');console.log(JSON.stringify(receipt));
